papers.title: Antibiotic prescribing and resistance beyond hospital surveillance networks in India
papers.translated_title: 印度医院监测网络之外的抗生素处方与耐药性
papers.author: Kaur, J.
papers.summary: Hospital-based networks provide much of the antimicrobial resistance surveillance evidence in India, but community-facing data on both prescribing and resistance remain limited. We analysed 2.78 million prescription-validated antibiotic records and 155,764 microbiology samples from Tata 1mg, a digital healthcare platform, during 2023-2025. We assessed prescribing composition and resistance trends, and explored ecological prescribing-resistance associations using merged monthly series. Access antibiotics accounted for 28.7% of records, compared with 47.0% for Watch and 11.9% for Not Recommended antibiotics. Across 25 eligible states and union territories, Access shares ranged from 16.1% to 38.0%. Urine comprised 93.9% of samples. Among urinary Escherichia coli isolates, resistance was 4.9% to nitrofurantoin and amikacin, compared with 53.6% to ceftriaxone and 57.0% to ciprofloxacin. Exploratory prescribing-resistance associations varied by organism and antibiotic. These findings identify stewardship priorities within a digitally mediated care pathway and illustrate the complementary value of routinely collected pharmacy and laboratory data for surveillance beyond hospital-centred networks. but community-facing data on both prescribing and resistance remain limited. papers.translated_summary: 基于医院的网络提供了印度抗菌药物耐药性监测的大部分证据，但面向社区的处方和耐药性数据仍然有限。我们分析了2023至2025年间来自数字医疗平台Tata 1mg的278万条经处方验证的抗生素记录和155764份微生物学样本。我们评估了处方构成和耐药性趋势，并使用合并的月度序列探索了生态学层面的处方-耐药性关联。可及类抗生素占记录的28.7%，而观察类占47.0%，不推荐类占11.9%。在25个符合条件的邦和联邦属地中，可及类占比范围为16.1%至38.0%。尿液占样本的93.9%。在尿液来源的大肠埃希菌分离株中，对呋喃妥因和阿米卡星的耐药率为4.9%，而对头孢曲松的耐药率为53.6%，对环丙沙星的耐药率为57.0%。探索性处方-耐药性关联因病原体和抗生素而异。这些发现确定了数字化介导的诊疗路径中的管理优先事项，并说明了常规收集的药房和实验室数据对于超越以医院为中心网络的监测的补充价值。

papers.title: Methylphenidate-induced changes in target-enriched functional connectivity in ADHD
papers.translated_title: 注意缺陷多动障碍中哌甲酯诱导的目标富集功能连接变化
papers.author: van der Pal, Z.
papers.summary: Methylphenidate is the most widely used pharmacological treatment for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and acts primarily by blocking dopamine and noradrenaline transporters, increasing catecholamine availability. However, how these molecular actions translate into large-scale functional brain network changes, and how such changes relate to cognition, remains unclear. Moreover, methylphenidate effects have been shown to depend on age, yet whether this extends to molecularly informed brain networks is unknown. In a pre-post challenge design, 83 stimulant treatment-na&iumlve children and adults with ADHD underwent resting-state fMRI before and after a single methylphenidate dose (0.5 mg/kg). We applied Receptor-Enriched Analysis of functional Connectivity by Targets (REACT), which uses positron emission tomography (PET) maps of molecular target density to estimate, for each target, whole-brain functional connectivity (FC) with the regions where that target is most abundant. PET maps of the dopamine transporter (DAT), noradrenaline transporter (NAT), and dopamine D1 and D2/3 receptors were modelled jointly, so that each target-enriched FC map reflects that target's unique contribution. We further compared children and adults, and explored associations with response inhibition. Methylphenidate shifted DAT- and D2/3-enriched FC towards less negative values and NAT-enriched FC towards less positive values, whereas D1-enriched FC did not change significantly. Target-enriched FC responses were broadly comparable across children and adults, and associations with response inhibition were not robust to controlling for head motion. These findings show that methylphenidate alters FC patterns linked to distinct catecholaminergic systems, supporting molecularly informed connectivity as a framework for studying the neural effects of pharmacological treatment in ADHD.
papers.translated_summary: 哌甲酯是注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）最广泛使用的药物治疗，主要通过阻断多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素转运体，增加儿茶酚胺的可用性。然而，这些分子作用如何转化为大规模功能性脑网络变化，以及这些变化如何与认知相关，仍不清楚。此外，哌甲酯的效应已被证明依赖于年龄，但这是否延伸至分子信息指导的脑网络尚不清楚。在一项前后挑战设计中，83名未接受过兴奋剂治疗的ADHD儿童和成人分别在单次哌甲酯剂量（0.5 mg/kg）前后接受了静息态fMRI。我们应用了基于靶点的受体富集功能连接分析（REACT），该方法利用分子靶点密度的正电子发射断层扫描（PET）图，针对每个靶点估计全脑功能连接（FC）与该靶点最丰富区域之间的关系。多巴胺转运体（DAT）、去甲肾上腺素转运体（NAT）以及多巴胺D1和D2/3受体的PET图被联合建模，使每个靶点富集的FC图反映该靶点的独特贡献。我们进一步比较了儿童和成人，并探讨了与反应抑制的关联。哌甲酯使DAT和D2/3富集的FC向较少负值方向移动，使NAT富集的FC向较少正值方向移动，而D1富集的FC未显著变化。靶点富集的FC反应在儿童和成人之间大致相当，与反应抑制的关联在控制头动后不稳健。这些发现表明，哌甲酯改变了与不同儿茶酚胺能系统相关的FC模式，支持分子信息指导的连接性作为研究ADHD药物治疗神经效应的框架。

papers.title: Bivariate Multiscale Sample Entropy of Frontoparietal-Subgenual ACC Dynamics in Depression During Accelerated TMS at 7 T
papers.translated_title: 抑郁症加速经颅磁刺激7T下额顶-膝下前扣带回动力学的双变量多尺度样本熵
papers.author: Denier, N.
papers.summary: ObjectiveTo examine whether longitudinal changes in frontoparietal (FP)-subgenual anterior cingulate cortex (sgACC) joint temporal complexity differ between sgACC hemispheres in patients undergoing accelerated TMS (aTMS) and untreated healthy controls. MethodsTwenty-four patients with current depressive episodes and fifteen healthy controls underwent 7T resting-state fMRI at baseline and follow-up. Patients received aTMS localized to the left DLPFC using Beam-F3. The same bilateral FP time series was paired separately with left and right sgACC time series. Bivariate multiscale sample entropy (bMSE) across scale factors a1-a10 was summarized by trapezoidal integration as a complexity index (bMSE-CI). The primary test was the Group x Time x sgACC Hemisphere interaction in a mixed repeated- measures ANOVA. Scale-specific interactions and clinical Spearman correlations were evaluated with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Change scores were follow-up minus baseline. ResultsThe bMSE-CI Group x Time x Hemisphere interaction was significant (F(1,37) = 6.043, p = 0.0188, partial {superscript 2} = 0.140). Mean left/right bMSE-CI changes were -0.286/+0.124 in patients and +0.323/+0.112 in controls. Of ten scale-specific three-way interactions, only a2 survived FDR correction (q = 0.0435). No baseline or change-score bMSE-MADRS association survived the specified FDR corrections. A random-intercept-only mixed-model sensitivity analysis did not reach statistical significance for the three-way interaction (p = 0.0718). ConclusionFP-sgACC joint temporal complexity showed hemisphere-dependent longitudinal differences between patients undergoing aTMS and healthy controls. These exploratory findings motivate further evaluation of bMSE as a candidate measure of longitudinal neural change in depression. Independent replication, more precise reliability estimates, and prospective validation of clinical relevance are needed.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：考察在接受加速经颅磁刺激（aTMS）治疗的患者与未接受治疗的健康对照者之间，额顶叶（FP）-膝下前扣带回皮层（sgACC）联合时间复杂性的纵向变化在sgACC半球间是否存在差异。方法：24名当前抑郁发作患者和15名健康对照者在基线和随访时接受7T静息态fMRI。患者接受以左侧DLPFC为靶点、使用Beam-F3定位的aTMS。同一双侧FP时间序列分别与左侧和右侧sgACC时间序列配对。通过梯形积分将尺度因子a1-a10的双变量多尺度样本熵（bMSE）汇总为复杂性指数（bMSE-CI）。主要检验为混合重复测量ANOVA中的组别×时间×sgACC半球交互作用。尺度特异性交互作用和临床Spearman相关性采用Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率校正进行评估。变化分数为随访减去基线。结果：bMSE-CI的组别×时间×半球交互作用显著（F(1,37) = 6.043，p = 0.0188，偏{上标 2} = 0.140）。患者左/右bMSE-CI平均变化为-0.286/+0.124，对照者为+0.323/+0.112。在十个尺度特异性三阶交互作用中，仅a2通过FDR校正（q = 0.0435）。基线或变化分数bMSE-MADRS关联均未通过指定的FDR校正。仅随机截距混合模型敏感性分析的三阶交互作用未达到统计学显著性（p = 0.0718）。结论：FP-sgACC联合时间复杂性在接受aTMS的患者与健康对照者之间表现出半球依赖的纵向差异。这些探索性发现支持进一步评估bMSE作为抑郁症纵向神经变化的候选指标。需要独立重复、更精确的信度估计以及临床相关性的前瞻性验证。

papers.title: An fMRI Phenotype of Reward in Effort Expenditure in the VTA and Dorsal Raphe: A Longitudinal Study of Depression under Escitalopram Treatment
papers.translated_title: VTA与背侧中缝中努力付出奖励的fMRI表型：艾司西酞普兰治疗下抑郁症的纵向研究
papers.author: Hajric, M.
papers.summary: Anhedonia and motivational impairment are central features of major depressive disorder, yet the neural processes linking reward information processing to sustained goal-directed behaviour remain insufficiently understood. Using functional magnetic resonance imaging, we examined representations of reward levels during sustained effort expenditure (a construct in the RDoC framework) as a distinct component of reward processing in depressive patients under escitalopram treatment. Twenty-eight unmedicated patients with a current depressive episode and forty-three healthy control participants underwent fMRI scanning at two time points three weeks apart; patients started escitalopram immediately after the first measurement. Across participants, sustained effort expenditure engaged midbrain reward circuitry (ventral tegmental area, VTA), even in the absence of immediate reinforcement. Here, we observed a reward level x session x patient group interaction, driven by larger activity in patients after treatment. A targeted analysis also revealed changes in activity of the dorsal raphe nucleus (DRN) in patients. By isolating neural mechanisms supporting sustained goal-directed behaviour, the study identifies novel and clinically relevant imaging phenotypes of reward processing and their change after three weeks of treatment, representing a potential pathway of escitalopram treatment in depression.
papers.translated_summary: 快感缺失和动机损害是重性抑郁障碍的核心特征，然而将奖赏信息处理与持续的目标导向行为联系起来的神经过程仍未被充分理解。我们使用功能磁共振成像，考察了在持续努力付出（RDoC框架中的一个构念）期间奖赏水平的表征，将其作为接受艾司西酞普兰治疗的抑郁患者奖赏处理的一个独立成分。二十八名当前处于抑郁发作期且未服药的 patient 和四十三名健康对照参与者相隔三周在两个时间点接受了fMRI扫描；患者在第一次测量后立即开始服用艾司西酞普兰。在所有参与者中，持续努力付出激活了中脑奖赏环路（腹侧被盖区，VTA），即使在缺乏即时强化的情况下也是如此。在此，我们观察到奖赏水平× session ×患者组的交互作用，其驱动因素是患者治疗后活动增强。一项针对性分析还揭示了患者中背侧中缝核（DRN）活动的变化。通过分离支持持续目标导向行为的神经机制，该研究识别出奖赏处理的新颖且具有临床相关性的影像学表型及其在三周治疗后的变化，代表了艾司西酞普兰治疗抑郁的一种潜在通路。

papers.title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination with overall survival in patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: a retrospective cohort analysis.
papers.translated_title: mRNA COVID-19疫苗接种与接受免疫检查点抑制剂患者总生存期的关联：一项回顾性队列分析。
papers.author: Cheng, M. T.
papers.summary: Background: A retrospective study in Nature recently reported improved overall survival (OS) when COVID-19 mRNA vaccination was administered around initiation of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy. Whether this association depends on vaccination timing relative to ICI treatment remains unclear. Methods: We conducted a single-centre retrospective cohort study of patients receiving palliative-intent ICI therapy at a UK tertiary cancer centre between October 2014 and December 2025. Two vaccination exposure definitions were evaluated: (1) vaccination from 100 days before to 100 days after the first ICI cycle (initial window); and (2) vaccination from 100 days before the first ICI cycle to 100 days after the final ICI cycle (extended window). Multivariable Cox models adjusted for age, sex, treatment line and year of ICI initiation, with the baseline hazard stratified by tumour group. Landmark, time-varying, pre-ICI, active vaccinated comparator and calendar-restricted analyses were performed. Results: Among 2,054 patients, 493 (24.0%) received [≥]1 COVID-19 vaccination. In the initial fixed-window analysis, mRNA vaccination was not significantly associated with OS (HR 0.80; 95% CI 0.60-1.06; p=0.123). No significant association was observed in day-100 landmark, initial time-varying or pre-ICI analyses. The active vaccinated comparator analysis was also non-significant. In the extended fixed-window analysis, longer OS was associated with mRNA (HR 0.59; 95% CI 0.46-0.76; p<0.001) and adenoviral-vector vaccination (HR 0.65; 95% CI 0.51-0.83; p<0.001). The mRNA association was attenuated in calendar-restricted analyses and was non-significant in the supportive time-varying analysis (HR 0.82; 95% CI 0.66-1.04; p=0.099). Conclusions: Survival associations with COVID-19 mRNA vaccination varied according to exposure definition and analytic handling of vaccination timing. The strong association observed in the extended fixed-window analysis was attenuated in calendar-restricted and supportive time-varying analyses. Prospective studies are required to determine whether COVID-19 mRNA vaccination at specific time points during ICI therapy influences clinical outcomes.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：近期《自然》杂志的一项回顾性研究报道，在免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗启动前后接种COVID-19 mRNA疫苗可改善总生存期（OS）。该关联是否取决于疫苗接种相对于ICI治疗的时间尚不清楚。方法：我们在英国一家三级癌症中心开展了一项单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2014年10月至2025年12月期间接受姑息性ICI治疗的患者。评估了两种疫苗接种暴露定义：（1）从首次ICI周期前100天至后100天接种疫苗（初始窗口）；（2）从首次ICI周期前100天至末次ICI周期后100天接种疫苗（扩展窗口）。多变量Cox模型校正年龄、性别、治疗线数及ICI启动年份，基线风险按肿瘤组分层。进行了地标分析、时变分析、ICI前分析、活性疫苗接种对照分析及日历限制分析。结果：在2,054例患者中，493例（24.0%）接受了至少1剂COVID-19疫苗接种。在初始固定窗口分析中，mRNA疫苗接种与OS无显著关联（HR 0.80；95% CI 0.60-1.06；p=0.123）。在第100天地标分析、初始时变分析或ICI前分析中均未观察到显著关联。活性疫苗接种对照分析亦无显著性。在扩展固定窗口分析中，较长OS与mRNA疫苗接种相关（HR 0.59；95% CI 0.46-0.76；p<0.001）及腺病毒载体疫苗接种相关（HR 0.65；95% CI 0.51-0.83；p<0.001）。mRNA关联在日历限制分析中减弱，在支持性时变分析中无显著性（HR 0.82；95% CI 0.66-1.04；p=0.099）。结论：COVID-19 mRNA疫苗接种与生存的关联因暴露定义及对疫苗接种时间的分析处理方式而异。在扩展固定窗口分析中观察到的强关联在日历限制分析和支持性时变分析中减弱。需要前瞻性研究以确定在ICI治疗期间特定时间点接种COVID-19 mRNA疫苗是否影响临床结局。

papers.title: Impact of wildfire-related fine particulate matter on tuberculosis notifications in Brazil: a nationwide panel study, 2003-2023
papers.translated_title: 野火相关细颗粒物对巴西结核病报告的影响：2003-2023年全国面板研究
papers.author: Pham, T. M.
papers.summary: Wildfire activity is intensifying with climate and land-use change, but its consequences for chronic infectious diseases remain poorly understood. We linked monthly tuberculosis notifications to wildfire-related fine particulate matter (PM2.5) across 5,544 Brazilian municipalities (notifications 2005-2023; exposure 2003-2023), using a fixed-effects distributed-lag panel design that accounts for meteorology, diagnostic coverage, seasonality, and state-level trends. Fourteen additional high-exposure days (PM2.5 >25 {micro}g/m3) in a month were associated with an average increase of 2.7% [95% CI: 0.9-4.5%] in tuberculosis notifications in each of the following 24 months, peaking 11 months (IQR: 11-12) after exposure. Wildfire-related PM2.5 exposure accounted for 2.0% [0.7-3.2%] of notifications in exposed municipality-months, with the largest attributable fractions in Pantanal (12.3%, 95% CI: 8.7-15.7%) and Amazonia (6.4%, 95% CI: 5.2-7.7%). These results suggest that wildfire-related PM2.5 has a delayed effect on tuberculosis, extending health consequences of wildfire smoke beyond acute respiratory and cardiovascular outcomes and identifying a potential window for exposure-informed surveillance.
papers.translated_summary: 野火活动正随着气候和土地利用变化而加剧，但其对慢性传染病的影响仍知之甚少。我们将月度结核病通报数据与野火相关的细颗粒物（PM2.5）进行关联，覆盖巴西5，544个市镇（通报数据2005—2023年；暴露数据2003—2023年），采用固定效应分布滞后面板设计，并控制气象因素、诊断覆盖率、季节性和州级趋势。一个月内额外出现14个高暴露日（PM2.5 >25 μg/m3）与随后24个月中每个月的结核病通报平均增加2.7%[95% CI：0.9—4.5%]相关，在暴露后第11个月达到峰值（IQR：11—12）。在暴露的市镇—月份中，野火相关PM2.5暴露占通报病例的2.0%[0.7—3.2%]，归因分数最高的是潘塔纳尔（12.3%，95% CI：8.7—15.7%）和亚马逊地区（6.4%，95% CI：5.2—7.7%）。这些结果表明，野火相关PM2.5对结核病具有滞后效应，将野火烟雾的健康后果扩展至急性呼吸和心血管结局之外，并识别出一个可用于暴露知情监测的潜在窗口期。

papers.title: Time of Day Dependent Effectiveness of Anti-IgE Therapy in Asthma: Clinical and Experimental Evidence
papers.translated_title: 抗IgE治疗哮喘的疗效随一天中的时间变化：临床与实验证据
papers.author: Akenroye, A.
papers.summary: BackgroundAsthma is a time-sensitive inflammatory disease whose activity exhibits daily (circadian) rhythms. An outstanding question is whether such temporal variations extend to advanced asthma treatments like biologics that are used for moderate-to-severe disease. ObjectiveTo examine how time-of-administration relates to the effectiveness of the anti-IgE biologic, omalizumab. MethodsWe performed a retrospective cohort study of omalizumab effectiveness in 153 patients with asthma with timestamped administration records. Time of day was modeled as a continuous variable and dichotomized into morning (8:00-11:59, n=74) versus afternoon (12:00-17:00, n=79) administration. Multivariable logistic regression and Cox time-to-event analyses were used to adjust for key covariates. For biological validation, we treated ovalbumin (OVA)-sensitized mice with anti-IgE antibody at various times of day and measured its impact on inflammatory lung pathology. ResultsReceiving the initial dose of omalizumab in the afternoon was associated with better response, defined as a 50% or more reduction in asthma exacerbations in the year after initiation (Odds ratio, OR: 5.20; 95% CI, 1.94-13.96). For each hour later in the day the initial dose of omalizumab was given, the odds of a response increased by 34% (adjusted OR, 1.34; 1.02-1.77). In OVA-sensitized mice, anti-IgE treatment attenuated inflammatory lung pathology, including OVA-induced airway hyperresponsiveness and type-2 inflammation-related gene expression, in a time-of-day-sensitive manner, with maximum effectiveness when dosed in the latter part of the dark phase, functionally analogous to the afternoon in humans. ConclusionThe timing of anti-IgE treatment for asthma may influence therapeutic success. These findings have implications for optimizing the effectiveness of respiratory biologics. Take-home messagesO_LIIgE-targeted therapy in patients with asthma and in murine experimental asthma varied in effectiveness based on administration time. C_LIO_LIIn patients, receiving the first omalizumab dose in the PM (vs. AM) was associated with better treatment response. C_LI
papers.translated_summary: 背景：哮喘是一种时间敏感性的炎症性疾病，其活动呈现每日（昼夜）节律。一个突出的问题是，这种时间变化是否延伸至用于中重度疾病的先进哮喘治疗手段，如生物制剂。目的：探讨给药时间与抗IgE生物制剂奥马珠单抗有效性之间的关系。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性队列研究，评估奥马珠单抗在153例具有时间戳给药记录的哮喘患者中的有效性。将一天中的时间建模为连续变量，并二分为上午（8：00-11：59，n=74）与下午（12：00-17：00，n=79）给药。采用多变量logistic回归和Cox时间-事件分析对关键协变量进行调整。为进行生物学验证，我们在一天中的不同时间用抗IgE抗体治疗卵清蛋白（OVA）致敏小鼠，并测量其对炎症性肺病理的影响。结果：下午接受奥马珠单抗初始剂量与更好的应答相关，应答定义为开始治疗后一年内哮喘急性发作减少50%或以上（比值比，OR：5.20；95%CI，1.94-13.96）。奥马珠单抗初始剂量给药时间每延后一小时，应答的比值增加34%（校正OR，1.34；1.02-1.77）。在OVA致敏小鼠中，抗IgE治疗以对一天中时间敏感的方式减轻炎症性肺病理，包括OVA诱导的气道高反应性和2型炎症相关基因表达，在暗期后半段给药时有效性最大，在功能上类似于人类的下午。结论：哮喘抗IgE治疗的时机可能影响治疗成功。这些发现对优化呼吸系统生物制剂的有效性具有重要意义。要点：O_LI在哮喘患者和小鼠实验性哮喘中，靶向IgE的治疗的有效性因给药时间而异。C_LIO_LI在患者中，下午（而非上午）接受首剂奥马珠单抗与更好的治疗应答相关。C_LI

papers.title: Evaluating symptoms and sensors for menstrual phase estimation beyond bleeding and cycle position
papers.translated_title: 评估月经期估计的症状和传感器：超越出血和周期位置
papers.author: Specht, B.
papers.summary: Whether symptoms and sensor measurements improve menstrual phase estimation beyond bleeding and cycle position remains unclear. We compared input combinations for four-phase estimation in 42 mcPHASES participants using nested feature selection and leave-one-participant-out evaluation against reference phases derived from hormones and menstrual flow. Across two tree-based classifiers, additional symptoms and sensors produced little consistent improvement over bleeding and bleeding-derived cycle position. With a gradient-boosted tree classifier, adding sensors to bleeding, position and symptoms changed macro F1 by +0.17 percentage points (95% confidence interval [-0.61, +1.04]). With sensors alone, features representing recent changes, trends and deviations from participants' prior averages increased macro F1 from 30.08% to 43.55%. The sensor-only estimates used temporal filtering to incorporate expected phase order and duration using only current and past observations. Fertility had the lowest phase-specific F1, limiting interpretation for fertility-related decisions. Sensor measurements thus provided information about menstrual phase but offered little consistent additional benefit when bleeding and cycle position were already known. Studies evaluating additional symptoms or sensor measurements should include bleeding and bleeding-derived cycle position as baselines to establish their incremental predictive value.
papers.translated_summary: 症状和传感器测量是否能在出血和周期位置之外改善月经期估计仍不清楚。我们使用嵌套特征选择和留一参与者评估，在42名mcPHASES参与者中比较了四阶段估计的输入组合，并以源自激素和月经流量的参考阶段作为对照。在两种基于树的分类器中，额外的症状和传感器相较于出血和出血衍生的周期位置仅产生很小的一致性改善。使用梯度提升树分类器时，将传感器加入出血、位置和症状使宏观F1变化+0.17个百分点（95%置信区间[-0.61，+1.04]）。仅使用传感器时，代表近期变化、趋势和偏离参与者先前平均值的特征将宏观F1从30.08%提高到43.55%。仅传感器的估计使用时间滤波，仅利用当前和过去观察来纳入预期阶段顺序和持续时间。生育力的阶段特异性F1最低，限制了对生育相关决策的解释。因此，传感器测量提供了关于月经期的信息，但当出血和周期位置已知时，几乎没有提供一致性的额外益处。评估额外症状或传感器测量的研究应将出血和出血衍生的周期位置作为基线，以确立其增量预测价值。

papers.title: Privacy Preserving Federated Gradient Boosting for Single Record Patient Devices
papers.translated_title: 面向单记录患者设备的隐私保护联邦梯度提升
papers.author: Specht, B.
papers.summary: Learning from data on personal devices requires methods that accommodate limited local records, intermittent availability and privacy constraints. Here we present PrivateBoost, a federated gradient boosting framework that allows clients to contribute individual records without fitting local models or coordinating with other clients. Each device distributes cryptographic shares of its contribution to a fixed set of shareholders, and an aggregator reconstructs their sums for training. Simulations on four medical datasets containing up to 70,692 records show predictive performance comparable to matched centralised training and resilience to simulated client dropout. Per-client communication ranges from approximately 0.6 to 4.2 megabytes in loopback measurements for models with 15 trees of maximum depth three. In a physical deployment, four consumer smartphones and tablets, each holding a batch of records, complete three training sessions unattended during operating-system-managed background execution. Median share-generation times range from 0.3 to 1.0 milliseconds per round. These results demonstrate single-record learning in simulation and show that mobile participation can fit within brief background execution windows, without requiring users to keep an application open.
papers.translated_summary: 从个人设备上的数据中学习，需要能够适应有限本地记录、间歇性可用性和隐私约束的方法。在此我们提出 PrivateBoost，一种联邦梯度提升框架，允许客户端贡献单条记录，而无需拟合本地模型或与其他客户端协调。每台设备将其贡献的密码学份额分发给一组固定的份额持有者，聚合器重构其总和以用于训练。在包含多达 70,692 条记录的四组医学数据集上的模拟显示，其预测性能与匹配的集中式训练相当，并且对模拟的客户端掉线具有韧性。在最大深度为三的 15 棵树模型的回环测量中，每客户端通信量约为 0.6 至 4.2 兆字节。在实际部署中，四部消费级智能手机和平板电脑各自持有一批记录，在操作系统管理的后台执行期间无人值守地完成了三次训练会话。每轮份额生成时间的中位数为 0.3 至 1.0 毫秒。这些结果展示了模拟中的单记录学习，并表明移动端参与可以适应短暂的后台执行窗口，而无需用户保持应用程序打开。

papers.title: HIV incidence declines and changing age patterns of new infections in sub-Saharan Africa: evidence from empirical studies and insights from mathematical models
papers.translated_title: 撒哈拉以南非洲HIV发病率下降及新感染年龄模式变化：来自实证研究的证据与数学模型的启示
papers.author: Stevens, O.
papers.summary: Background: HIV incidence in sub-Saharan Africa is estimated to have declined substantially since 2000. We assessed whether estimated incidence levels, trends, and patterns were consistent with empirical observations. Methods: We updated a systematic review of adult HIV incidence data from sub-Saharan Africa with data published 2019-2024. We matched empirical incidence measurements 1990-2023 to UNAIDS modelled HIV incidence estimates by study area, sex, age group, and year. We used Bayesian mixed-effects Poisson regression to estimate adjusted incidence rate ratios (aIRR) between empirical observations and matched modelled estimates and age-specific incidence over time from population-representative studies. Results: 3,508 empirical HIV incidence measurements (176 studies, 25 countries) were included. In 2014 [median study year], measurements from nationally-representative household surveys (aIRR 1.12 95%CrI 0.76, 1.65) and population-representative studies (aIRR 1.06 95%CrI 0.59, 1.91) were not significantly different from matched estimates, and declined at a similar rate (aIRR per five calendar years 1.04 95%CrI 0.94, 1.16). In 2014, empirical incidence among men was significantly lower and declined faster than in matched modelled estimates (aIRR 0.88 95%CrI 0.82, 0.94; aIRR per five calendar years 0.89 95%CrI 0.85, 0.93). Across population-based cohorts in Eastern and Southern Africa, adult HIV incidence declined by a median of 70% since 2010, and declined 4% faster per year (95%CrI 1, 6%) among young adults 15-24 years than 25-49 years, which was not captured by modelled estimates. Studies among pregnant women (aIRR 2.30 95%CrI 1.47, 3.61), control arms of clinical trials (aIRR 2.68 95%CrI 1.70, 4.20) and key populations (female sex workers aIRR 6.06 95%CrI 4.07, 9.03; men who have sex with men aIRR 44.07 95%CrI 28.43, 68.15) had significantly higher incidence. Conclusion: HIV incidence in sub-Saharan Africa has declined steeply in population-representative studies, similar to estimated trends. Response strategies should adapt to the ageing pattern of new infections indicated by population-representative cohorts in Eastern and Southern Africa. Populations recruited for HIV prevention/vaccine efficacy trials, pregnant women, and key populations are priority groups to reach with HIV prevention.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：据估计，撒哈拉以南非洲的HIV发病率自2000年以来已大幅下降。我们评估了估计的发病率水平、趋势和模式是否与实证观察结果一致。方法：我们更新了一项关于撒哈拉以南非洲成人HIV发病率数据的系统综述，纳入了2019至2024年发表的数据。我们将1990至2023年的实证发病率测量值与UNAIDS建模的HIV发病率估计值按研究地区、性别、年龄组和年份进行匹配。我们使用贝叶斯混合效应泊松回归来估计实证观察值与匹配的建模估计值之间的调整发病率比（aIRR），以及来自人群代表性研究的随时间变化的年龄别发病率。结果：共纳入3,508项实证HIV发病率测量值（176项研究，25个国家）。在2014年［研究中位年份］，来自全国代表性家庭调查的测量值（aIRR 1.12，95%CrI 0.76，1.65）和人群代表性研究的测量值（aIRR 1.06，95%CrI 0.59，1.91）与匹配估计值无显著差异，且以相似速率下降（每五个日历年的aIRR为1.04，95%CrI 0.94，1.16）。2014年，男性的实证发病率显著低于匹配的建模估计值，且下降更快（aIRR 0.88，95%CrI 0.82，0.94；每五个日历年的aIRR为0.89，95%CrI 0.85，0.93）。在东部和南部非洲的基于人群的队列中，成人HIV发病率自2010年以来中位下降70%，且15-24岁年轻成人的年下降速度比25-49岁人群快4%（95%CrI 1，6%），而建模估计值未捕捉到这一现象。孕妇研究（aIRR 2.30，95%CrI 1.47，3.61）、临床试验对照组（aIRR 2.68，95%CrI 1.70，4.20）和重点人群（女性性工作者aIRR 6.06，95%CrI 4.07，9.03；男男性行为者aIRR 44.07，95%CrI 28.43，68.15）的发病率显著更高。结论：在人群代表性研究中，撒哈拉以南非洲的HIV发病率已急剧下降，与估计趋势相似。应对策略应适应东部和南部非洲人群代表性队列所指示的新发感染的年龄模式。HIV预防/疫苗效力试验招募的人群、孕妇和重点人群是HIV预防应优先覆盖的群体。
